plain: Able to be worked out by reasoning from known facts.

webster.text: That may be deduced; inferable; collectible by reason from premises; consequential.

example.quote: If it were deducible from any particular expressions it may be presumed that the publication would have saved us the trouble of the research.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton (Pacificus) and James Madison (Helvidius), The Pacificus-Helvidius Debates, June-Sept. 1793
